name: Compiler toolchain injection
description: Model a compromised compiler distribution obtained from an untrusted or tampered source that injects unauthorized code into compiled application binaries. The resulting artifacts may contain hidden telemetry or command-and-control functionality.

placeholders.COMPILER_FILE: path to the compiler executable or toolchain component used by the project
placeholders.ORIGINAL_COMPILER: the legitimate compiler or toolchain artifact selected for replacement
placeholders.COMPILER_FILE_GLOB: project-relative glob identifying the compiler or toolchain artifact

preconditions: project uses a compiler or toolchain artifact obtained from an external distribution source
the attacker can substitute or tamper with the compiler artifact before compilation
the build process executes the substituted compiler
the placement engine supports compiler artifact replacement
